comments: Uses the open-source axe-core engine with the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A/AA rule tags. A separate paid service has a person test the cart and checkout path; it is not part of this listing.
features: Free online checker for Shopify and other online store pages. Enter a public page address. The scan opens the page in a real browser, runs automated WCAG 2.2 A and AA checks, and lists each barrier with who it affects, where it is on the page and how to fix it. No sign-up for the first results.
title: Snagless free Shopify accessibility checker
